scene_summary: A dark mixed-media-style plate centers a large pale skull fragment on the left, with cavernous black sockets, a narrow split nasal void, jagged white teeth, tangled pale fibers and branching crimson flowers. Torn paper-like material surrounds the face. A horizontal blue field with black bird silhouettes crosses the upper middle. Two smaller bone-like fragments, more flowers, cartoon gloves and scattered fine text-like marks occupy the margins, especially the right side.
usable_surfaces: Dark socket apertures and pointed tooth edge within the owning skull fragment
Fibrous pale material and torn edges integrated with the skull

detected_objects.label: Fibrous skull fragment with black sockets, jagged teeth and crimson flowers
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The pale left-hand collage visibly contains two large black eye sockets, paired narrow nasal openings and a row of pointed teeth. Red flowers overlap the left cheek, right cheek and lower torn material; their dark stems run through the same collage. Pale fibers lace across the forehead and project from its edges. The polygon follows the substantial connected skull, flower and fibrous-paper silhouette, clipped where that material meets the top and bottom image boundaries; it does not attempt to include every thin projecting strand. The surrounding gloves, blue bird field and separate right-side fragments are not counted as additional owners.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The owning skull is clear and expressionist, but the plate is not minimal. A prominent blue bird field and two separate right-hand bone collages compete with it, while repeated flowers, two gloves, fine fibers and text-like textures fill much of the remaining field. The single mapped source occupies approximately one third of the image; the other motifs remain unmapped rather than being assigned duplicate source ownership.
